claim: The ?demo=1 sample opens half-finished and resets without changing daily progress.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert four selected sample tiles, reset, demo-prefixed session keys, preserved daily storage, and cleared demo storage on exit

claim: Everyone receives the same route for each UTC date.
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; assert the visible UTC date and identical generated solutions
fresh browser context; place a tile, reload, and assert the restored route

claim: A daily route reaches an end screen, opens archive practice, and can be restarted.
sandbox: fresh browser context; play the published solution, assert end screen and archive action, restart, reload, and assert archive access

claim: Archive practice opens only after today’s UTC daily route is complete.
sandbox: fresh browser context; deny direct practice with no marker and yesterday’s marker, then allow it only when the marker exactly matches today’s UTC date

claim: Practice uses routes from earlier dates and does not change today’s route.
sandbox: save a partial daily route, set today’s completion marker, assert practice=1 uses yesterday’s UTC date, complete it, and assert daily storage is unchanged
fresh browser context; unlock practice, complete an archive route, assert the visible non-scored label, unchanged daily marker, and no score or ranking storage key

claim: The puzzle works with keyboard and touch input.
sandbox: fresh keyboard context and a separate 390px touch context; complete the published route in each

claim: Mouse clicks follow the same route rules.
sandbox: fresh browser context; use page.mouse clicks on every step of the published sample solution and assert the end screen

claim: Each published date has a known route that can be completed.
sandbox: generate representative published-date puzzles, apply each known solution, and assert completion

claim: The game shows the date before play and a route code after completion.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the visible UTC date before play, finish the published solution, and assert its visible route code

claim: Route rendering sustains at least 50 frames per second in the test browser.
sandbox: fresh demo page; repeatedly add and remove a route tile during a timed requestAnimationFrame sample, then require at least 50 frames per second

claim: The daily puzzle is free and starts without an account or payment step.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the playable grid is visible with no account fields, buy action, subscription, or payment step

claim: The game has no accounts, rankings, streak penalties, analytics, ads, remote fonts, or third-party scripts; game progress sends no request body.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; play and reset the sample while recording requests, then assert same-origin GET-only traffic with no bodies, same-origin script/style/font resources, and no account, ranking, streak, analytics, or ad controls

claim: Reaching the tile limit blocks the next tile until a tile is removed or the route is restarted.
sandbox: fresh daily puzzle; build a legal non-winning route to its tile limit, assert the announced block, remove one tile, and assert a route tile can be added again

claim: Selecting the previous tile or pressing Backspace removes the latest tile and lets play continue.
sandbox: fresh demo; add one tile, select the previous tile, add it again, press Backspace, and after each removal assert exactly one tile is removed and the next tile can be added

claim: A puzzle that is already loaded remains playable if the browser goes offline.
sandbox: new browser context; load /demo, set that context offline, place the next route tile, and assert progress
